name: Safety vest
summary: Hi-vis orange safety vest with reflective bands, shown on a hanger; for roadworks, site and worker scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the hanging vest's floor shadow sits at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 460 px tall); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the vest swings like a pendulum from the hook
